title: Planning gives each case a sprint goal clause lists (providers, statuses) a check in the item that carries the clause
goal: precheck SP warns when a sprint goal clause names a list of cases (such as 'a GitHub, arXiv or PyPI answer' or 'a failed request') and the carrying item's goal or checks name only some of them, so a narrower item goal is widened or the clause reworded before the start gate. SP-vk3wf746 close: BG-o3zppi2w checked GitHub and arXiv shapes but no PyPI answer, and BG-npdpbmw2 named status 0 where the sprint goal said a failed request; the review found both (BG-x4lhztge, BG-2ksqvskp).
